why_relevant: Only dedicated Macedonian-language banking vertical portal (active since 2017). Publishes bank product launches, digital-channel rollouts and vendor-enabled services (e.g. NLB Smart POS / SoftPOS) that are the visible end of an unannounced technology contract. Category page /category/banki/ gives a clean banking-only stream.

Leading MK business/economy portal (founded by K. Shajnovski and A. Manev). Carries vendor-and-bank technology stories including explicit implementation news (OneID / SignPlus by KIBS + Nextsense in Macedonian banks) — i.e. named vendor-bank pairings that never appear in a tender register.

source_name: Pari.com.mk — business, finance and personal development magazine
why_relevant: Finance-focused MK medium covering banks, insurers, pension and investment funds; publishes bank rankings and IT-company rankings — useful both for deal news and for building the vendor/actor map (e.g. 'најмоќни ИТ компании во македонска сопственост').

Established MK economy/business magazine with analyses and interviews; deep archive (pagination reaching thousands of pages) makes it valuable for retrospective reconstruction of bank/vendor deals and procurement disputes.

Economy/business news portal with an ЕКОНОМИЈА category; covers investment announcements, conferences (Bloomberg Adria Skopje) and corporate moves — a secondary confirmation channel for deals first surfacing elsewhere.

Long-running MK economy and business weekly; historically the outlet for corporate/banking deal reporting and tender controversies. URL asserted from the brand's known domain and Wikipedia entry for the title — treat domain as unverified until the liveness pass runs.
Business news site covering Macedonian economy, financial markets and the business sector; carries SME/finance content and republished corporate announcements.

Aggregates virtually every MK outlet into topic streams. The single most efficient discovery layer for this cell: one crawl surfaces which outlets published a given bank/vendor story, and snowballs new outlet domains automatically.

Mainstream MK news site that actively reports national payment-infrastructure milestones (MIPS modernisation with EU support, TIPS/instant-payments accession confirmed by ECB, Western Balkans payment-system interlinking) — exactly the programme-level signals that precede procurement.

Private MK news agency; wire-style economy desk that carries National Bank and ministry statements verbatim, including payment-system modernisation announcements. Agency copy is the upstream text many portals republish, so it is the earliest catchable version.

Oldest MK daily; its economy desk publishes bank product/technology launches (e.g. Sparkasse Bank's rebuilt S-Banka mobile app) which flag underlying digital-banking platform work and vendor engagement.

Telma's КОД team won the Nikola Mladenov award for a serial investigation into energy-sector tenders, documenting corrupt conduct by state institutions in multi-million procurements. Demonstrated capacity and appetite to expose state tender mechanics — transferable to IT/payments procurements.

source_name: Center for Civil Communications (ЦГК) — procurement monitoring publications
why_relevant: NGO that publishes recurring monitoring reports and news on public procurement practice in North Macedonia. Not media per se, but its reports name contracting authorities, recurring winners and irregularity patterns, and are the analytical feedstock MK business media quote — an efficient pointer into both actors and stories.

source_name: IT.mk — Macedonian ICT sector portal and IT Index company registry
why_relevant: MK-language ICT media that also runs an 'IT Индекс' directory of Macedonian ICT companies and an /dejnost/it-kompanii/ listing, plus a long-lived forum thread enumerating IT solution providers. Best single instrument for building the local vendor/actor map that makes media contract-win stories legible.

source_name: Kariera.mk — business/IT sector rankings and company features
why_relevant: Publishes MK-language features ranking domestically owned IT companies; useful supplementary actor-map input and an early indicator of which vendors are scaling (hiring, revenue) around banking projects.

Mainstream MK portal; carried the launch/positioning coverage of Faktor.mk itself, illustrating its role as a meta-reporter on the business-media landscape, and covers corporate/economic news generally. Secondary confirmation and outlet-discovery value.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com.mk — advice/news section on payment-services regulation
why_relevant: Unexpected but real MK-language carrier of payments-regulation explainers (e.g. 'Наскоро нови услуги за плаќања – Народна банка ги донесе подзаконските акти'). Signals when secondary legislation opens new licensed-payment-service markets, which is the precondition for new PSP procurement.

source_name: Karanovic & Partners — North Macedonia payments law commentary (EN)
why_relevant: Regional law-firm client alerts in English explain the 2022 Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems and its EU-harmonised consequences. English-language bridge that decodes the Macedonian regulatory vocabulary used in the local press.

source_name: Central Banking — North Macedonia country/organisation feeds (EN)
why_relevant: Specialist English trade press tracking the National Bank of North Macedonia, including technology and payments-infrastructure initiatives. Complements the mk-language press with vendor-relevant framing; largely subscription-gated.

Very high-volume MK classifieds site (400k+ active listings claimed) with a jobs vertical; smaller PSPs, e-money institutions and integrators that do not pay for premium boards often post here. Useful for catching non-bank payment players (fintech, exchange offices, POS service firms).
Additional MK job aggregator; extra coverage layer for bank/vendor postings not mirrored elsewhere.

source_name: Агенција за вработување на РСМ - е-Работа (тековни огласи)
why_relevant: Official state employment-agency register of current vacancies. Employers (including banks and state-owned financial institutions such as Развојна банка) have statutory reasons to register vacancies here, so it captures postings that never reach commercial boards. Government-run, stable, low-noise on employer identity.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје - Новости / Огласи за вработување
why_relevant: Primary-source career/news feed of a systemic MK bank; observed publishing 'Активни огласи за вработување' items. First-party wording of a role (department, system named) is richer than aggregator summaries and is the canonical artefact to cite.
